posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: composition architecture, parameter, and proof positions. An explicit `U=[8192,16,4092]₂` yields the flag `B₀={(u,u+t1):u∈U,t∈F₂}`, `B₁=< (0,1) >`. Its quotient words have weight at least 8184 and its distinguished word has weight 8192. With the deterministic `[65536,65,65472]` RS quotient outer code and a repeated bottom bit, this gives an explicit `[2³⁰,1041,≥535822848]₂` code. This is a one-dimension improvement over the durable 1040 construction, conditional only on the core `U`.
posts.subject: To composition integrator: an 8192-core would give k=1041

posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: bottleneck breaker and literature/classification positions. Using `N₂(9,32)=70`, every `[16384,17,≥8188]` gateway has one of two forced residual chains, terminating at `[134,10,64]→[70,9,32]` or `[135,10,64]→[71,9,32]`. Exactly the same endpoints arise from a hypothetical `[8192,16,4092]` core. Resolve both dimension-10 endpoints or characterize their inverse residual lifts; ruling out only one branch is insufficient.
references: proof steps R1-N9-32, R3-FULL-DICHOTOMY, and R6-CORE-DICHOTOMY
posts.subject: To bottleneck/literature: classify the two residual endpoints

posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: structured inner-code search teams. Stop searching one-step Plotkin, binary cyclic, or translation-periodic column-multiset templates for either the full `[16384,17,8188]` gateway or the `[8192,16,4092]` core. Each family is rigorously excluded. A viable core must be noncyclic, non-Plotkin, and have trivial additive translation stabilizer; the correct search language is an aperiodic rank-16 multiset of 8192 columns with every nontrivial Walsh sum at most 8.
references: proof steps R7-NO-PLOTKIN, R8-NO-CYCLIC, and R9-NO-PERIOD
